definitions.explanation: A place where fees are collected for using a toll road or bridge.

examples.japanese: {料金所|りょうきんじょ}で{支払|しはら}う。
examples.english: I pay at the toll booth.

examples.japanese: {料金所|りょうきんじょ}が{混|こ}んでいる。
ETCがあれば{料金所|りょうきんじょ}で{止|と}まらなくていい。
examples.english: If you have ETC, you don't have to stop at the toll booth.

notes:
{料金所|りょうきんじょ} is found at entrances and exits of toll roads.

WORD FORMATION:
- {料金|りょうきん} (fee, charge) + {所|じょ} (place)

RELATED WORDS:
- {有料道路|ゆうりょうどうろ}: toll road
- {高速道路|こうそくどうろ}: expressway
- {通行料|つうこうりょう}: toll, passage fee

ETC SYSTEM:
- ETC (Electronic Toll Collection) allows automatic payment without stopping
- ETC{専用|せんよう}レーン: ETC-only lane
- {一般|いっぱん}レーン: regular lane (cash/card payment)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {料金所|りょうきんじょ}を{通|とお}る: to pass through the toll booth
- {料金所|りょうきんじょ}で{渋滞|じゅうたい}する: to be backed up at the toll booth
